gaps.title: Texas registry adds 200 Cybercabs in one day, taking the count to 773
gaps.whyItMightMatter: Nov. 17 batch put Cybercabs ahead of Model Ys on the Texas list; registration is not riders in service

gaps.title: Miami Robotaxi geofence roughly doubles, still short of the beach
gaps.whyItMightMatter: Service area grew from about 31 to about 59 square miles and now includes downtown; Miami Beach is still out

gaps.title: Musk says customer-owned Robotaxi trials may start next month
gaps.whyItMightMatter: Conditional December pilot would pull ahead of the Q2 2027 timing given on the Q3 call

gaps.title: Tesla opens Argentina orders for Shanghai-built Model 3 and Model Y
gaps.whyItMightMatter: Direct sales started Nov. 21 with five trims from $40,990, but first deliveries are not expected until March or April 2027
